workflowSummary: Write and design your posts (job openings, culture content, employee spotlights) once, then schedule them to go out across LinkedIn, Instagram, and other channels at set times — all from one calendar view instead of logging into each platform separately.
samplePrompt: Schedule these 4 employer branding posts to go out on LinkedIn and Instagram over the next two weeks, one every few days.
beginnerNote: straightforward calendar interface, minimal setup
pricingNote: Buffer has a free plan for small teams; Hootsuite pricing on request (verify before publishing)
accessNotes: Public blog post; verify current free-tier limits and pricing on each vendor's site before publishing.

persona: TA team running a hiring push for one specific role, event, or location
title: build a landing page for a specific hiring campaign or career fair
workflowSummary: Instead of sending candidates to your general careers page, build a focused, single-purpose page for one campaign (a specific role, city, or event) with one clear call to action, like 'apply now' or 'join our talent community' — no developer needed.
samplePrompt: Build a landing page for our upcoming career fair in Austin, with a short pitch about open roles and a signup form to join our talent community.
beginnerNote: template-driven, but choosing the right template and messaging takes a little marketing judgment
pricingNote: Not publicly listed; typically quote-based (verify before publishing)
accessNotes: Public blog post; verify current pricing on each vendor's site before publishing.

persona: Recruiter without a marketing background who needs to promote a role
title: draft social media posts to promote an open role
workflowSummary: Describe the role and where you're posting (LinkedIn, Instagram, etc.); one tool drafts short, scroll-stopping copy in the right tone for that platform, and the other turns the job details into an eye-catching graphic — so you can post without hiring a copywriter or designer.
samplePrompt: Write 3 short LinkedIn post variations to promote our open UX Designer role, each with a different hook, plus a matching graphic with the role title and key details.
beginnerNote: describe the role, get ready-to-post copy and graphics back
pricingNote: Both offer free tiers; paid plans for higher usage (verify before publishing)
accessNotes: Public blog post; verify current free-tier limits on each vendor's site before publishing.

persona: TA leader trying to justify recruitment marketing spend to leadership
title: see which recruitment marketing channels actually drive quality hires
workflowSummary: The platform combines your job ad spend data with actual hiring outcomes from your ATS, so instead of just seeing which channel got the most clicks, you can see which channels actually produced hires — and where you're wasting budget.
samplePrompt: Show me which of our recruitment marketing channels produced the most actual hires last quarter, not just the most applicants or clicks.
beginnerNote: this is an analytics platform that needs ATS and ad-spend data connected first, typically set up by a TA ops or marketing team
pricingNote: Not publicly listed; typically quote-based (verify before publishing)
accessNotes: Public blog post; verify current pricing and reporting capabilities on the vendor's site before publishing.

persona: HR marketer who needs eye-catching creative but has no design skills
title: turn a job description into a social-ready graphic or ad creative
workflowSummary: Paste in the key details from your job description (title, salary range, location, a few perks); the tool drops them into a branded, ready-to-post graphic template sized correctly for LinkedIn, Instagram, or a job board ad — no design software needed.
samplePrompt: Turn this job description for our Delivery Driver role into a LinkedIn-sized graphic with the title, pay range, and 'apply today' call to action.
beginnerNote: template-driven drag-and-drop editor
pricingNote: Free plan available; Canva Pro from roughly $13/month (verify before publishing)
accessNotes: Public blog post; verify current pricing on the vendor's site before publishing.

persona: HR/recruiting team wanting more reach for open roles without manual posting
title: automatically distribute a job posting across social media channels
workflowSummary: Connect your ATS or job feed once; whenever a new role opens, the tool automatically formats and posts it across your company's social media accounts (LinkedIn, Facebook, X, etc.) without a recruiter manually creating and posting each one.
samplePrompt: Automatically post any new job opening in our Sales department to our company's LinkedIn and Facebook pages as soon as it's approved.
beginnerNote: one-time setup connecting your ATS and social accounts, then it runs automatically
pricingNote: Not publicly listed; typically quote-based (verify before publishing)
accessNotes: Public blog post; verify current pricing and supported platforms on the vendor's site before publishing.

persona: In-house recruiter / TA coordinator
title: Screen and rank resumes against a job description
workflowSummary: Recruiter uploads a batch of resumes plus the job description; the tool parses each resume, semantically matches it to the role's requirements, and returns a ranked shortlist with visible reasoning so the recruiter can sanity-check the top matches instead of reading every resume manually.
samplePrompt: Here's the job description for [role]. Score and rank the attached resumes against the must-have requirements: [list them], and flag any candidate missing a hard requirement.
beginnerNote: easy to use once resumes are uploaded, but a recruiter should learn how the ranking logic works before trusting it fully
pricingNote: Manatal from $15/user/mo; Skima AI $49/mo — verify before publishing
accessNotes: Third-party review site; confirm current pricing/features on each vendor's own site before quoting

persona: HR generalist / hiring manager writing a req
title: Write a clear, unbiased job description that attracts more applicants
workflowSummary: HR types in the role, seniority, and a few responsibilities; the tool drafts a structured JD (summary, responsibilities, qualifications) and can score or rewrite it to remove exclusionary language before it's posted to job boards.
samplePrompt: Write a job description for a [seniority] [role title] at a [industry] company. Keep the tone friendly and jargon-free, and flag any language that might discourage diverse applicants.
pricingNote: Workable free JD tool; Textio paid plans on request — verify before publishing
accessNotes: Third-party review site; Textio and Workable both have their own product pages with current pricing

persona: TA coordinator scheduling interview loops
title: Automatically schedule interviews across recruiter, interviewer, and candidate calendars
workflowSummary: Instead of emailing back and forth to find a time, the tool checks everyone's calendar, proposes times a candidate can self-book, and automatically rebalances or reschedules when an interviewer declines.
samplePrompt: Find a 45-minute slot next week where [candidate name], [interviewer names], and I are all free, and send the candidate a self-scheduling link.
pricingNote: Calendly from $10/seat/mo; GoodTime pricing on request — verify before publishing
accessNotes: Third-party review site; confirm current plans directly with each vendor

persona: Technical/agency recruiter sourcing passive talent
title: Find and reach passive candidates on LinkedIn and beyond who aren't actively applying
workflowSummary: Recruiter describes the role in plain language; the tool searches hundreds of millions of profiles across LinkedIn, GitHub, and other sites, ranks candidates by fit, and can kick off outreach sequences to the ones who look like a match.
samplePrompt: Find 20 candidates with 5+ years of [skill] experience in [location] who aren't actively job-hunting, and prioritize ones who've changed roles in the last 2 years.
beginnerNote: the search works out of the box, but getting good outreach reply rates takes some trial and error
pricingNote: Pricing on request for both — verify before publishing
accessNotes: Third-party review site; verify current features/pricing with hireEZ and SeekOut directly

persona: Hiring manager or recruiter prepping for interviews
title: Generate role-specific interview questions from a job description
workflowSummary: Paste in a job title (or full job description) and seniority level; the tool returns a tailored mix of behavioral, situational, and skills-based questions, often with what to listen for in a strong answer.
samplePrompt: Generate 8 interview questions for a [seniority] [role title], mixing behavioral and situational questions, and tell me what a strong answer to each one looks like.
pricingNote: Free
accessNotes: Free tool page; confirm no login/data-sharing requirements before use with real candidate info

persona: HR/hiring manager extending a job offer
title: Draft a compliant, professional offer letter in minutes
workflowSummary: HR fills in role, salary, start date, and benefits; the tool formats a complete offer letter and flags common compliance gaps (missing at-will language, missing contingencies) before it's sent to the candidate.
samplePrompt: Draft an offer letter for [candidate name] for the role of [title], starting [date], salary [amount], with a 5 business day response deadline and a background-check contingency.
pricingNote: Free, no sign-up required — verify before publishing
accessNotes: Free tool; still have offer letters reviewed by HR/legal for local labor-law compliance

persona: HR/People Ops onboarding a new hire
title: Build a 30-60-90 day onboarding checklist for a new hire
workflowSummary: HR enters the role and start date; the tool generates a phase-by-phase checklist (pre-boarding, day one, first week, first 30-60-90 days) covering IT setup, paperwork, training, and manager check-ins, and can assign tasks automatically.
samplePrompt: Create a 30-60-90 day onboarding checklist for a new [role title] joining a [team size]-person team, organized by Day 1, Week 1, Week 2, and Weeks 3-4.
pricingNote: Rippling ~$8-15/user/month per module; BambooHR pricing on request — verify before publishing
accessNotes: Third-party review site; confirm current per-module pricing directly with each vendor

persona: People manager writing performance feedback
title: Draft performance review feedback from rough notes
workflowSummary: Manager types in a few bullet points about an employee's achievements and growth areas; the tool turns them into a clear, professional review draft the manager then edits for accuracy and tone before sharing.
samplePrompt: Turn these notes into a performance review for [employee name], [role]: [bullet list of achievements and growth areas]. Keep the tone constructive and specific, not generic.
pricingNote: Easy-Peasy.AI has a free generator; ClickUp Brain requires a paid plan — verify before publishing
accessNotes: Third-party review site; avoid pasting confidential employee data into free/consumer tools without checking their data policy

persona: HR leader trying to reduce turnover
title: Run and analyze exit interviews to understand why people are leaving
workflowSummary: Departing employees complete a structured survey; the tool uses AI text analysis to surface recurring themes (pay, management, growth) across many exit interviews so HR can spot patterns instead of reading each response in isolation.
samplePrompt: Summarize the top 3 recurring themes from this quarter's exit interview responses, and flag any comments related to management or compensation.
beginnerNote: survey setup is simple, but interpreting the AI-surfaced themes benefits from HR judgment
pricingNote: Pricing on request for both — verify before publishing
accessNotes: Third-party review site; exit feedback is sensitive — confirm confidentiality settings before rollout

persona: HR team fielding repetitive employee questions
title: Let employees self-serve answers to HR policy questions (PTO, benefits, remote work)
workflowSummary: The chatbot is trained on the company's own handbook, benefits guide, and policy documents; employees ask questions in plain language in Slack or Teams and get an instant, sourced answer instead of emailing HR.
samplePrompt: Set this chatbot up to answer employee questions using our employee handbook and benefits guide, and have it hand off to a real HR person for anything about an individual's pay or performance.
beginnerNote: needs an initial setup/training step on company documents before it's reliable
pricingNote: Pricing on request for both — verify before publishing
accessNotes: Third-party review site; keep compensation/individual-case questions routed to a human, not the bot

persona: Recruiter finalizing a candidate before an offer
title: Automate reference checks instead of chasing referees by phone
workflowSummary: Recruiter enters the candidate and referee contact info; the tool sends referees a short survey they can complete on their phone, then summarizes and scores the responses so the recruiter isn't stuck playing phone tag.
samplePrompt: Send a reference check survey to [referee name] for [candidate name]'s application to [role], and summarize the responses with a score once all references are in.
pricingNote: Pricing on request for both — verify before publishing
accessNotes: Third-party review site; get candidate consent before contacting references, per standard hiring practice

persona: Recruiter running back-to-back candidate interviews
title: Automatically summarize and score interview notes into a candidate report
workflowSummary: The tool joins or records the interview call, transcribes it, and turns the conversation into a structured candidate report mapped to the interview rubric — so the recruiter isn't typing notes while also trying to run the conversation.
samplePrompt: Summarize this interview against our scorecard for [role]: strengths, concerns, and a recommended next step, using only what the candidate actually said.
pricingNote: Free to sign up with a work email — verify before publishing
accessNotes: Vendor blog; get candidate/interviewer consent before recording or transcribing calls

persona: HR/recruiter finalizing a job post before it goes live
title: Check a job post for biased or exclusionary language before posting
workflowSummary: HR pastes in a drafted job post; the tool scores it and highlights specific words or phrases statistically linked to lower application rates or reduced diversity, with suggested rewrites.
samplePrompt: Score this job posting for biased or exclusionary language and suggest specific rewrites for anything that could discourage diverse applicants: [paste job post].
pricingNote: Paid plans on request; limited free trial — verify before publishing
accessNotes: Third-party review site; use as a second pass after drafting, not as the sole source of the JD

persona: Agency or in-house recruiter doing outbound sourcing
title: Write a personalized cold outreach email to a passive candidate

tools.name: Recruit CRM AI Candidate Outreach Email Generator

workflowSummary: Recruiter pastes in a candidate's background and the open role; the tool drafts a short, specific outreach email or InMail (with subject line) that references the candidate's actual experience instead of reading like a mass template.
samplePrompt: Write a short cold outreach email to a [role] candidate with a background in [specific skill/experience], inviting them to a 15-minute call about [role] at [company]. Keep it under 150 words.
pricingNote: Free — verify before publishing
accessNotes: Free tool; avoid including personal characteristics or demographic proxies in outreach prompts

persona: Recruiter/hiring manager evaluating candidate ability before interviews
title: Give candidates a skills test before the interview instead of relying on resumes alone
workflowSummary: Recruiter picks or builds a short assessment matched to the role (cognitive, technical, or a realistic work sample); candidates complete it online, and the tool auto-scores results so recruiters can compare candidates on demonstrated ability rather than resume claims.
samplePrompt: Build a 30-minute assessment for a [role title] candidate that tests [specific skill], including one realistic work-sample task, and auto-score the results.
beginnerNote: building a good assessment takes a bit of setup the first time
pricingNote: TestGorilla has a free tier; Vervoe from $19/mo — verify before publishing
accessNotes: Third-party review site; confirm candidates are told in advance that AI scoring is used, where required by local law

persona: TA team hiring at high volume (retail, hospitality, healthcare)
title: Screen and pre-qualify high-volume frontline applicants over chat or text
workflowSummary: Applicants text or chat with a conversational assistant that asks qualifying questions, answers their questions about the role, and books a next step for anyone who qualifies — built for roles where speed matters more than deep, individualized screening.
samplePrompt: Set up a chat screener for [frontline role] that asks about availability, required certifications, and location, and automatically books a video interview for anyone who qualifies.
beginnerNote: powerful but built for enterprise-scale hiring, so setup involves more configuration
pricingNote: Enterprise-only pricing, contact sales — verify before publishing
accessNotes: Third-party review site; not a fit for low-volume or highly specialized hiring

persona: Candidate or recruiter preparing for a video screening round
title: Conduct one-way video interviews for early-stage screening
workflowSummary: Candidates record themselves answering a set list of questions on their own time; recruiters and hiring managers then review and shortlist the recorded responses in bulk instead of scheduling a live call for every applicant.
samplePrompt: Set up a one-way video interview for [role] with these 4 questions: [list], and let me review and shortlist responses afterward.
beginnerNote: easy for recruiters, but some candidates find async video less comfortable than a live call
pricingNote: Pricing on request for both — verify before publishing
accessNotes: Third-party review site; tell candidates in advance if AI is used to score their responses

persona: HR generalist at a small business writing internal policy
title: Draft an HR policy or handbook section (e.g. a remote work or expense policy)
workflowSummary: HR describes the policy area and a few company-specific details; the tool drafts a structured policy document (purpose, scope, rules, examples) that HR then reviews and customizes to match local labor law and company practice before publishing it in the handbook.
samplePrompt: Draft a remote work policy for a [company size] company, covering eligibility, expected availability hours, and equipment reimbursement. Keep the tone clear and non-legalistic.
pricingNote: Free tier available — verify before publishing
accessNotes: Free tool; always have HR-specific and location-specific policies reviewed by legal before publishing
